title: Candidate and power loop body
statement: The body assigns $0$ to a candidate variable and $1$ to a power variable. While the power variable is less than an argument variable, each iteration doubles the power variable and increments the candidate variable by $1$; the body then assigns the candidate variable’s value to the argument variable.
